description:
From rising temperatures to shifting ecosystems, Earth has a lot to tell us. We, the curious explorers of Earth, noticed that our home planet has been sending us some alarming signals. So, we decided to put on our detective hats, and turn mountains of satellite data into stories worth discovering.
Our mission? Visualizing NASA observations over time to uncover environmental trends, connect the dots, and reveal what’s really happening to our planet. So… who said science couldn't be an adventure?
